# Store Platform - Comprehensive Knowledge Base

## Philosophy & Quality Standards
Our store offers authentic, curated products engineered for superior quality and reliability.
All items meet strict quality control standards and come with verified authenticity seals.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants
Q: Is Cash on Delivery available?
A: Yes, Cash on Delivery (COD) is available across all 64 districts in Bangladesh with no advance payment required for standard retail orders.

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Inside Dhaka takes 24 to 48 hours. Outside Dhaka takes 48 to 72 hours via trusted courier partners.

Q: Are products authentic?
A: Yes. All inventory is 100% genuine and verified with authentic supplier verification.

Q: How can customers contact support?
A: Customers can reach support by phone/WhatsApp at +880 1700-000000 or email at support@store.com.
